channel.title: CUS Solution Insights
channel.description: Practical guidance from CUS Solution's consultants and engineers on cloud cost, AI adoption, modernization, reliability, security, staffing, and early-career tech.

item.title: Zero Trust Isn't a Product: A Practical Cybersecurity Roadmap
item.description: Most breaches exploit missing basics, not zero-day exploits. A practical, risk-first cybersecurity roadmap covering identity, cloud security, compliance, and incident response for growing enterprises.

item.title: Modernizing Legacy Systems Without a Big-Bang Rewrite
item.description: Full rewrites fail more often than they ship. Here is how to modernize legacy systems incrementally — strangler-fig migration, seams, and shipping value along the way.

item.title: Designing for Reliability: SRE Practices That Scale
item.description: Site reliability engineering is less about heroics and more about disciplined defaults. Here are the SRE practices that scale with your team — SLOs, error budgets, and blameless learning.

item.title: Building a Standout Tech Portfolio as a New Graduate
item.description: Grades open doors; a portfolio gets you hired. Here is how new graduates can build projects that prove real skills — depth over breadth, README-first, and shipping something real.

item.title: Cutting Cloud Costs Without Slowing Teams Down
item.description: A practical FinOps playbook: reduce cloud spend 20–40% through visibility, right-sizing, commitment planning, and a lightweight cost culture — without slowing delivery.

item.title: Choosing the Right Tech Staffing Model
item.description: A hiring manager's guide to matching the engagement model — contract, contract-to-hire, or direct placement — to the shape of the work, budget, and timeline.

item.title: From Pilot to Production: Enterprise AI Adoption
item.description: Why most enterprise AI pilots stall before production, and a stage-gated adoption path — use-case selection, data readiness, evaluation, and governance — that ships value.
